terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use object-space mechanical terms and distinguish observed reference evidence from inferred hidden construction.

reasoning: The multi-view vehicle combines a deep mechanical hierarchy with repeated spokes, fasteners, cargo and rigging.
The tall sail, paired runners and wheel system are independent silhouette owners and motion systems.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Separate silhouette owners and motion pivots are required for the approved vehicle identity.

details.description: Copper spar and binding around the cream triangular sail
Copper outer bands around dark timber wheel rims
Eight radial timber spokes per wheel
Copper fasteners around rims and hubs
Copper-banded transverse rails and runner struts
Copper collars spaced along the timber mast
Timber boxes with copper latches and open snow-packed tops
Tensioned rope loops securing cargo and sail
Silver fish bodies resting on pale ice

proceduralStrategy: Bevelled BoxGeometry for the chassis and cargo modules.
TorusGeometry plus radial spoke cylinders for independently rotating wheels.
Extruded ShapeGeometry for grounded runners with upturned noses and for the double-sided triangular sail.
Deterministic instance counts by quality tier; no downloaded meshes or baked lighting.

definitionOfDone: Phone-scale read matches the approved long wheel-and-ski freighter silhouette, tall cream sail and premium seafood cargo.
Front, profile, rear and underside show coherent construction and grounded contact.
Wheel, suspension and sail pivots are action-ready and reduced motion produces a stable static pose.

featureGroups.name: Wheel and ski silhouette
qualityCriteria: Four deep spoked wheels and two long grounded runners remain distinct in front and profile.

featureGroups.name: Cream copper-edged sail
qualityCriteria: The mast, boom, thick sail and rear face remain coherent across orbit views.

featureGroups.name: Readable seafood cargo
qualityCriteria: Fish, ice, boxes and crab accents read as premium seafood rather than coloured blocks.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not add micro rope stitches before the dual running gear passes.

mustNotDo: use bright blue or aurora colours

lightingFromPhoto: Upper-left key light, ACES filmic tone mapping and exposure matched to the existing Frostmoon world.
Cool hemisphere fill and ordinary moon rim preserve runner and sail thickness at night.
Soft contact shadows and ambient occlusion ground both runners and all four wheels without hiding the underframe.

visualEvidence.cameraView: profile plus island three-quarter and low orbit
visualEvidence.notes: Runtime model holds as a real volume across multiple island orbits. Final placement is grounded on a dedicated ice spur and no longer intersects the Frostwell mission platform.

featureReviews.notes: Four deep wheel circles and paired full-length runners remain distinct in profile.
The enlarged cream sail, mast and copper booms now match the tall long-haul identity.

reviewHistory.aiVisionNotes: The representative blockout clears its two required critical features. Automated IoU remains non-authoritative because the isolated white-background concept view is compared with a cluttered live gameplay scene; its failure and missing map-stripped capture remain recorded in tier1Results. Seafood cargo is readable but remains a structural/material-pass concern rather than a blockout veto.

assumptions: The fixed dual-contact wheel-and-ski construction is a stylized visual mechanism, not a manufacturable deployment system.
Hidden cargo arrangement may vary while preserving the approved silhouette.
risks: Sail can dominate phone composition if placed too close to the route.
Four wheels plus spokes can exceed low-tier draw-call budget without reuse.
Seafood can collapse into generic blobs below phone-scale cue thresholds.
